The entries live in the private GitHub repository . Every save becomes a commit there under your own GitHub name, so the history of each entry shows who changed what and when.

  1. Your GitHub account needs write access to that repository. If you do not have it yet, ask the repository owner to add you as a collaborator.
  2. Create a fine-grained token at github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new. Resource owner: . Repository access: Only select repositories, this one. Repository permissions: Contents, Read and write. Nothing else.
  3. Paste the token below. It stays in this browser and is used only to talk to GitHub.
